property_summary: For any callee address and value, calling sendMoney on the reference never reverts and therefore allows the callee's fallback to execute and persist state changes (i.e., the call succeeds); the mutant that requires the low-level call to return ok will revert when the callee's fallback reverts, preventing those state changes from persisting.
change_summary: Replace low-level call with a call that checks the return value and reverts on failure, which can prevent depositsCount changes in fallback of target from persisting due to revert.
